_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The score sits in a statistical coil where 97% of 12h windows hold within ±2 points, and the analyst's breaker for an UP move (ETF flows turning positive for 3+ consecutive days with funding below 40) has not fired — IBIT has 8 consecutive days of outflows — so HOLD with conviction is the skilled call that wins when the score holds.
next_move.brains_agree: No — the narrative implies forward upside via accumulation bottom framing while the analyst explicitly calls HOLD; consensus sides with the analyst on direction (HOLD) but rejects the analyst's Panic phase label as incoherent with the 55-62 score band, anchoring instead at Disbelief.
next_move.confirmed_if: ETF flows turn positive for 3+ consecutive days AND funding drops below 40 (institutional bid returns without speculative excess)
next_move.invalidated_if: ETF outflows accelerate below -20 AND VIX breaks above 75 (risk-off liquidation cascade) OR funding spikes above 70 with price flat (leveraged long trap before breakdown)
